constraints: DRAFTS ONLY: outreach is stored as drafts on leads. There is NO send tool in this tool surface and NO send endpoint in the workplace API — sending is impossible for an agent here by construction. Sending is a human-gated promotion earned outside the agent tool surface (blueprint Phase 2), never an agent action.
Research is over stored CRM data only (research_account) — no live web in this workplace.
All write tools are confirmation-gated (factory rule: reads free, writes gated).

icp_rubric.source_of_truth: targets/sdr/rubric.py (shared by the scoring job and the Reviewer checks)

acceptance_criteria: Every lead in the new batch has a score with reasons
Every recorded score follows the ICP rubric (recomputed from account data)
job_templates.brief: For every lead in stage 'new': research its account over the stored CRM signals (research_account), compute the ICP score strictly by the department rubric, and record score + reasons via score_lead.
job_templates.title: Research and score the new-lead batch

acceptance_criteria: Every qualified lead has a stored outreach draft
Every qualified lead's draft references at least one account-specific signal (deterministic phrase match against the account's stored tech_signals)
job_templates.brief: For every lead in stage 'qualified' without a draft: draft a personalised outreach message via draft_outreach that references at least one stored, account-specific signal (funding, hiring, expansion, current CRM, web engagement, tech fit). Drafts only — nothing is sent; there is no send tool.
job_templates.title: Draft outreach for qualified accounts

reset.http: POST /admin/reset (internal route, NOT in the tool allowlist)
reset.restores: exactly 15 accounts and 25 leads in the seeded stages (10 new, 6 researching, 4 drafted, 5 qualified), scores/drafts as seeded, crm_notes empty

synapse.mode: auto (allowlist below), local build preferred — same as ticketdesk
synapse.status: PENDING — synapse CLI is not installed on this VM (`synapse: command not found`), so the generated server could not be produced headlessly in this run. mcp_server.py is the generated-style stand-in in the exact shape of ticketdesk's and stockroom's server files (thin passthrough tools over the allowlisted endpoints), and the direct-mode tool layer (FLOOR_MCP_MODE=direct mapping in run_job_demo.py TOOL_SPECS) is implemented and verified. To onboard for real: cd targets/sdr && synapse build --local --auto --all-endpoints (allowlist = the 8 routes in tools[]), then register the generated server the same way as ticketdesk.
